title: How to use PoRoom
subtitle: Screenshots show the real screens filled with sample data.
writerGuideLink: Browse the writer's guides (writing habits and craft articles)

main.title: [PoRoom] Find, create and join rooms
main.intro: PoRoom is the home screen for finding, creating and entering rooms to focus in.
steps: Deadline & Dawn rooms: always-open rooms for up to 50 people. Join with one button and focus together.
Create a room: pick a name, color, tags, record visibility and join type (invite code or open).
Join with an invite code: enter the 6-character code to get into a private room.
All / recommended rooms: filter by tag and join open rooms right away. Before entering, you can choose the nickname to use in that room.
My status: today's character count, attendance calendar, to-dos and this month's personal rank at a glance.

room.title: [Room] A studio to focus together
room.intro: Inside a room you get participant cards, chat, the Pomodoro timer and the character log on one screen.
steps: Participant cards: see everyone's online status, focus/break and work status live. Turning on screen share shows your work screen as a pixelated mosaic, so the content stays hidden.
Pomodoro: set focus and break times and start. Your progress shows on your card, and the timer keeps running when you visit other pages.
Character log: set today's goal and enter your starting and current character counts. Webtoon artists add the number of cuts.
Chat: talk with the room and send whispers. The bubble color you pick also becomes your profile photo border. The owner can delete messages or reset the chat.
Records, Calendar, Polls, Board: the room's record table, schedule, polls, notices and posts.
Status & nickname: set your status (writing, revising...) and change the nickname you use in this room only.

feed.title: [Feed] Share today's news
feed.intro: A place to leave a short note about your day and cheer on other creators.
steps: Post your day: add a short mood note; today's focus time and character count (cuts for webtoon) are filled in from your real records.
Browse by type: ALL, Work, Duel, Challenge, Submission and Contest tabs.
Cheer others: tap reactions on other posts to show support.
You can also share duel and challenge results, publisher submissions and contest news.

compete.title: [Compete] Duels and challenges
compete.intro: Keep goals going with duels and challenges.
steps: Duels: compete over the same period by characters, cuts or work time. Join an open duel, create one with 'New duel', or join with an invite code.
Challenges: take on goals like writing 5,000 or 10,000 characters a day. They reset weekly or monthly on Korean time.
Duels and challenges you joined are listed at the top; past challenges appear under 'Ended challenges'.
Duel results are reflected in the duel win/loss ranking on [Ranking] after the period ends.

ranking.title: [Ranking] See where you stand
ranking.intro: Characters, work time, duels, challenges and typing speed — all rankings in one place.
steps: Overall ranking: by room or by person, daily/monthly/yearly. Use the < > buttons to browse past dates.
Novel/Webtoon toggle: shown separately so characters and cuts never mix.
Duel win/loss, challenge and typing rankings are on the same screen.
Your rank and percentile appear in the bar at the bottom.

rest.title: [Rest] Take a break
rest.intro: Take a short break to practice typing or chat with other writers.
steps: Typing practice: type along to see your speed and accuracy and keep your best record.
Choseong quiz & word chain: light games to clear your head.
Info board: read and share contests, writing tips and questions.
Recruit board: find writing partners or room members; you can link a post to your room.
